# f5xc_v1_http_monitor (Data Source)

V1HttpMonitor data source

The `f5xc_v1_http_monitor` data source allows you to retrieve information about an existing configuration within your F5 XC tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "f5xc_v1_http_monitor" "example" {
  name      = "example_v1_http_monitor"
  namespace = "example_namespace"
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `external_sources` (Attributes List) External Sources Internet facing monitor sources (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_sources))
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) follow_redirects Controls if the monitor will follow redirects while determining health
- `health_policy` (Attributes) health_policy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_policy))
- `ignore_cert_errors` (Boolean) ignore_cert_errors Controls if an SSL error will result in a change of health status
- `interval_choice` (Attributes) interval How often the monitor will run from each source location (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interval_choice))
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `method_choice` (Attributes) method Must select POST, PATCH, PUT, or DELETE to enable Body Content (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--method_choice))
- `on_failure_count` (Number) on_failure_count The number of times a monitor must fail before the global monitor changes health
- `receive` (String) receive The regex pattern that the monitor looks for in the returned resource. If the text string is returned, the monitor is healthy. Note, headers are not considered in the matching.
- `request_headers` (Attributes List) request_headers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--request_headers))
- `response_codes` (List of String) response_codes HTTP response codes which will result in a healthy monitor. Use '*' as a wildcard character.
- `response_timeout` (Number) response_timeout The amount of time in milliseconds before the monitor considers a pending request to be a failure
- `sni_host` (String) SNI Host Override A string value which will override the default SNI host
- `source_critical_threshold` (Number) source_critical_threshold The number of provider-regions a monitor must fail from before the global monitor changes health
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
- `url` (String) url
